message_excerpt: Fixed binary converter not validating non-string or invalid base64 key/value (#1215)
proposition: POST /topics/{topicname}: contract says binary record keys and values use base64-encoded strings and invalid records return 422; implementation does coerce object or array keys and values through JsonNode.asText before base64 decoding, admitting empty-byte records instead of rejecting their representation
